```yaml
name: Deploy Server

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-npm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Jest tests (with JUnit reporter)
        id: jest
        run: |
          npx jest --ci --runInBand --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit > jest_output.txt 2>&1
          echo "JEST_OUTPUT=$(cat jest_output.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Filter Jest output (remove PASS lines)
        id: filter
        run: |
          grep -v '^ PASS ' jest_output.txt > jest_filtered.txt
          echo "JEST_FILTERED=$(cat jest_filtered.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Upload filtered Jest logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jest-logs
          path: jest_filtered.txt

      - name: Publish Jest test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Jest Tests
          path: test-results.xml
          reporter: jest-junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          only-summary: true
          fail-on-error: true
          fail-on-empty: true
          working-directory: .
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Jest coverage
        id: coverage
        run: |
          npx jest --coverage --coverageReporters=lcov > coverage_output.txt 2>&1

      - name: Filter coverage output (remove PASS lines)
        run: |
          grep -v '^ PASS ' coverage_output.txt > coverage_filtered.txt

      - name: Upload filtered coverage logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jest-coverage
          path: coverage_filtered.txt

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
```
